decisions.state_note: o000: visible window approximately x31–95, y143–207 is mostly white; tiny dark fragments meet its upper-right and lower-right edges. Shape unknown.

o001: window about x63–127,y143–207 shows a thick dark stroke slanting upward-right from x100,y200 toward x120,y150, cropped at top and bottom; detector reports upright and rising-right portions. Small dark fragment at upper-left edge. Digit unresolved.

o002: window about x63–127,y111–175 shows a rounded dark mass at x78–111,y111–146 joining a thick right-hand descending stroke near x112–126. Upper structure is cropped; detector reports no instances. Need upper view to distinguish digit structure.

o003: window x63–127,y79–143 shows a thick rising-right stroke from near x87,y130 to x109,y79, with white to its right and another dark region entering the right edge near y113. Detector supports the diagonal. Possible 4; junction remains cropped.

o004: window x95–159,y79–143 shows two dark rising-right portions separated by a narrow white recess around x111–135,y80–114; dark material spans much of lower window. Detector reports rising-right band near (137,107). Possible 4 remains unconfirmed; upper portions cropped.

o005: window x95–159,y47–111 shows two separated thick rising-right strokes, with rounded upper caps near (119,48) and (156,56). Detector supports the left diagonal. Their lower connections remain outside this view; 4 is a hypothesis.

o006: window x95–159,y79–143 repeats o004: two slanted dark portions flank a white recess ending near y116; broad dark region below. Detector again reports rising-right band near (137,107). Lower junction and right stroke need inspection.

o007: window x95–159,y111–175 shows a broad dark junction above a thick stroke descending leftward toward x110,y175, with white on both sides below y145. Together with the two upper capped strokes in o005 and intervening recess in o004, this supports digit 4.
